subject: Latency spike on April 23 — request for relief and trial extension
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@hipporetail.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@hipporetail.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency spike on April 23 — impact and request for relief

Hi Michael,

We had a significant latency regression across our inference calls on Saturday, April 23 (approx 02:30–05:10 UTC). During the window our checkout recommendation API saw 4–6x p99 increases and several timed-out requests. That caused checkout delays for a subset of our shoppers and kicked off 3 high-severity incidents on our side (ops team attached logs).

Impact summary:
- Estimated 18k affected inference calls during the window
- ~0.9% increase in cart abandonment observed in the following 12 hours
- Two scheduled campaigns saw degraded performance

We raised a ticket (INF-7281) and the Redwood support notes confirm the platform was degraded in the us-west region while you rolled a runtime patch. We appreciate the fast response from your CS/infra teams but this did exceed our risk tolerance given we're in peak prep for a marketing push.

Request: Given the customer impact, Hippo Retail is requesting a goodwill gesture — specifically: 1) a credit to cover the impacted usage (we estimate ~12k API credits / equivalent of $8,500) and 2) a 60-day trial extension for the additional staging throughput we were planning to run next month (this helps us recover confidence quickly).

I've attached our incident logs and the ops summary. Happy to hop on a quick call if it helps.

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Head of Platform Reliability
Hippo Retail

Attachments: hippo_incident-logs-20270423.zip
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@hipporetail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency spike on April 23 — impact and request for relief

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the logs. First, I want to apologize for the disruption — we know any extra latency at checkout is material. I've looped in Marissa (your AE) and Hannah (CS lead) so we can coordinate an immediate remediation and a proposed remediation package.

Short-term next steps:
- Marissa/Hannah: can you confirm whether Hippo would accept a one-time credit + trial extension as described, or do you need a different structure (e.g., partial credits + rate-limited free quota for the next two months)?
- I'll open the internal approval thread with finance/legal and provide the incident postmortem once infra finishes the timeline.

Sara — we'll aim to get a formal proposal by EOD Tuesday; if that's too slow please let me know and we can pull resources earlier.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: FW: Latency spike on April 23 — proposed relief for Hippo Retail

Team —

Saw the notes from Sara. Hippo is on a mid-market committed pilot (Deal DL-2987) and they're in a critical ramp period. My suggested remediation offer to start internal routing:
- One-time goodwill credit: $10,000 applied to their account (covers the usage spike and gives runway)
- 60-day trial extension for their staging environment (adds a temporary free quota to rebuild confidence)
- A short SLA makegood addendum (one page) that confirms the window and the agreed remediation terms

Rationale: preserves relationship through launch and keeps runway for expansion. Hippo has a clear path to a paid Dedicated commitment later this year.

Aditya — can finance/legal sign off on a $10k credit + 60-day extension? If you prefer, we can structure as 8k credit + 90-day extension; call out what needs a DocuSign.

Hannah — please prepare a customer-facing incident summary and attach the infra timeline once INF-7281 is closed. I'll draft the makegood addendum and circulate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency spike on April 23 — proposed relief for Hippo Retail

Hi team —

Finance acknowledges the need for a goodwill gesture on account of the incident. A few notes from legal/finance:
1) $10,000 one-time credit is approvable but requires the customer to sign a short acknowledgment (one-page makegood addendum) confirming they accept the credit in lieu of additional claims related to this incident. We can prep DocuSign.
2) Trial extension for staging (60 days) is fine; mark it in billing rules so it won't auto-expire into charged usage.
3) Attach the incident timeline (INF-7281 resolution) and support logs as part of the internal approval packet.

If Hippo insists on a larger amount, escalate to VP Sales. Otherwise I can route the $10k credit now and generate the DocuSign link.

— Aditya
Legal & Finance Liaison, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, David Lee <david.lee@hipporetail.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency spike on April 23 — confirmation of credits and next steps

Hi Sara / David —

Thanks again for the patience while we reviewed this internally. We can confirm the following remediation package:

1) One-time goodwill credit of $10,000 applied to Hippo Retail's account (will appear as a billing credit; not taxable).
2) 60-day staging/trial extension for the current pilot environment — we will add a billing rule so staging usage within that window does not incur charges.
3) A one-page makegood addendum that documents the incident window (Apr 23, 02:30–05:10 UTC) and the agreed remediation. We will send via DocuSign for signature; execution is required to finalize the credit.

Next steps:
- I'll share the DocuSign link (Aditya is prepping) and the draft makegood (attached).
- Hannah will follow up with the incident postmortem and the infra timeline when INF-7281 is closed.
- Credits will be issued within 3 business days after we receive the signed addendum.

If you'd like to review the wording live, we can run a 30-minute call tomorrow morning PT.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
